For low desire, erections or low testosterone: the approved medicines, and what the online "PT-141" really is.

One peptide is FDA approved for low desire, in premenopausal women, and needs a prescription. Sildenafil and tadalafil are FDA-approved pills for erections. The same molecule as that peptide, sold as PT-141 by online shops, is not an approved product.

  • Enclomiphene · pharmacy-made pill for low testosteroneNot FDA approved; pharmacy-madeon prescription

    A pill some online clinics prescribe for low testosterone. Pharmacy-made, not FDA approved for any use.

    A pill some clinics prescribe for low testosterone. It is not FDA approved for any use, so only pharmacies make it. 11

    Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made.

    Tadalafil mixes and PT-141 made by a pharmacy, sold by online clinics on prescription. Not FDA approved.

    Pharmacy-made versions sold by online clinics, some mixed with other medicines. Not checked by the FDA batch by batch.

    Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made.

    The same molecule as Vyleesi, in vials labelled for lab use, no prescription. Not an approved product.

    The same molecule as Vyleesi, sold without a prescription by research-use shops: no dose control, no checks.

  • Bremelanotide (Vyleesi) · shot for low desire in womenFDA approvedon prescription

    A shot you take before sex, on prescription. Approved for low sexual desire in premenopausal women.

    A shot you take before sex, approved for low sexual desire in premenopausal women.

    FDA approved.

  • Sildenafil (Viagra) · pill before sex for erectionsFDA approvedon prescription

    A pill about an hour before sex, on prescription. Helps erections; works only with sexual stimulation.

    A pill taken about an hour before sex. It helps erections and works only with sexual stimulation. 8

    FDA approved for erectile dysfunction.

    Prescription, from an online clinic or your doctor.

  • Tadalafil (Cialis) · pill for erections, before sex or dailyFDA approvedon prescription

    A pill before sex or once a day, on prescription. Helps erections; works only with sexual stimulation.

    A pill taken before sex, or at a lower dose once a day. It helps erections and works only with sexual stimulation. 9

    FDA approved for erectile dysfunction.

    Prescription, from an online clinic or your doctor.

  • Testosterone (TRT) · gel or shot for low testosteroneFDA approvedon prescription

    A gel or shot on prescription. Approved only for men with low testosterone from a medical condition.

    Replaces a hormone the body makes too little of. Not FDA approved for low testosterone without an associated medical condition. 10

    FDA approved only for low testosterone with an associated medical condition.

    Prescription, after blood tests.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet

    A daily pill on prescription for women under 65 with low sexual desire that causes distress. Not a peptide.

    FDA approved for low sexual desire in women under 65.
